VIN.constraint: Actual DC, ripple, ringing and transient VIN at every IC must meet its operating limits and output headroom. A 5.5 V screen is at the ceiling, not a 5.5 V nominal supply with extra ripple allowance. 10 V MLCC rating does not relax regulator limits.

TPS628640B_UVLO.required_falling_slew_when_VIN_drops_bel: slower than 10 mV/µs (TI section10); recommended conditions table gives 10 mV/µs maximum
TPS628640B_UVLO.constraint: Verify actual connector/cable/source/load-disconnect and brownout waveforms at U22/U23. Local capacitance increase by itself does not prove this requirement; account for all shared-rail loads, discharge/backfeed paths and source behavior.

TPS6282xA_UVLO.constraint: UVLO protects low-voltage behavior but is not a valid-operating-voltage target. Check EN/PG behavior and existing CORE-PGOOD-enabled downstream sequence during slow/fast supply changes.

inrush_ramp.nominal_total_change: 120 µF across 12 positions to176 µF across 8; +46.7% nominal
inrush_ramp.input_charge_constraint: Input capacitors directly load VIN before switching. Internal output soft-start does not limit their initial source charging current. Use actual voltage-dependent charge/energy and source impedance/current limit; validate rise time, connector hotplug, overshoot and brownout recovery.
inrush_ramp.source_current_parameterization: Icap≈Cdiff(V,T,AC,age)*dVIN/dt; constant nominal C is only a first-order approximation.
inrush_ramp.output_soft_start_context: TPS6282xA internal controlled startup and TPS62864 approximately1ms output ramp do not by themselves validate a changed shared input bank.

ripple_and_transients: Validate input RMS/peak current and capacitor surface heating for each bank; compare actual spectral content with ESR/impedance and thermal evidence. Manufacturer typical ripple curves at10/100/500/1000kHz do not guarantee MHz converter behavior.
A single 22 µF part carries the entire local pulse current in four banks; two 10 µF parts previously could share it. Capacitance equivalence is not ESR/ESL/current-sharing equivalence.
Use measured/simulated source/cable/filter impedance to check input resonance, hotplug ringing and interaction with constant-power converter loads.
Check worst simultaneous six-rail startup/load steps, dynamic CPU/KPU voltage changes, current-limit/HICCUP recovery and loss of VIN.
Assess charge-driven droop, ESR steps and loop-inductance spikes; floor capacitance alone does not establish transient performance.
current_loop: Place each input bank as close as practicable to the actual regulator VIN and GND/PGND pins with short, wide conductors and low-inductance return.
Keep U22/U23 input return on PGND pins; maintain separate quiet VOS/FB sensing and protect it from SW nodes.
Preserve existing 100 nF local bypass positions; do not credit remote banks on shared VIN_5V as replacements for a local high-frequency loop.
A larger 1206 body may make local placement worse even when aggregate area arithmetic looks acceptable; verify before adopting ref removals.
thermal_and_life: Capacitor surface including self-heating must remain inside -55..125C and the eventual life-qualified envelope. Enclosure air 85°C, if assumed elsewhere, is not capacitor temperature.
Establish the application life, maximum sustained load and production/model bounds; generic 10% aging/model factors remain scenario assumptions.
required_decision_before_CAD_adoption: Approve the specific reference/value/count plan separately after reviewing this assessment. This assessment is not adoption or production release.
